title: Partie 1 · Papa Ananas vend la maison pour une banane en or 🍍
caption: Partie 1 · Papa Ananas a fait le pire investissement de sa vie… Tu aurais fait quoi à la place de Kiwi ? 👇 #fruits #ia #histoire #pourtoi #drole

papa.name: Papa Ananas
papa.look: Papa Ananas, a big chubby anthropomorphic pineapple dad with spiky green leaves as hair, bushy eyebrows, a thick brown mustache, wearing a stained white tank top and grey sweatpants

kiwi.name: Kiwi
kiwi.look: Kiwi, a small cute anthropomorphic kiwi fruit boy, about 8 years old, fuzzy brown skin, big round eyes, wearing a red hoodie and sneakers

maman.name: Maman Pêche
maman.look: Maman Peche, an elegant anthropomorphic peach mom with rosy pink fuzzy skin, a green leaf on her head, wearing a yellow apron

vendeur.name: Le vendeur
vendeur.look: a shady anthropomorphic grape bunch salesman wearing sunglasses, a purple suit and golden chains

scenes.setting: a cozy messy family living room, warm evening light

shots.action: Papa Ananas proudly holds up a shiny golden banana in a glass box, beaming with pride, while little Kiwi stares at it in shock
close-up of little Kiwi looking horrified with his mouth wide open, Papa Ananas grinning in the background

lines.text: Une banane en or massif. On est riches, mon fils.
Papa… on dort où ce soir ?

scenes.setting: a dark rainy city street at night with neon signs

shots.action: flashback: a shady grape bunch salesman in sunglasses whispers to Papa Ananas in a dark alley, showing him a glowing golden banana inside an open briefcase
Papa Ananas hands a huge stack of cash and house keys to the grinning grape salesman

lines.text: Cette banane vaut un million. Demain, deux millions.
Après-demain, je serai loin. Euh… je veux dire, tu seras riche !

scenes.setting: the doorway of the family house, morning

shots.action: furious Maman Peche stands in the doorway with her hands on her hips, glaring at Papa Ananas who hides the golden banana behind his back, Kiwi peeking from behind her
Maman Peche taps the golden banana and a piece of gold paint flakes off revealing a normal yellow banana underneath, Papa Ananas looks devastated

lines.text: Pourquoi il y a un camion de déménagement devant chez nous ?
C'est de la peinture. Elle s'en va avec le doigt.

scenes.setting: a city sidewalk next to a cardboard box, sunset

shots.action: little Kiwi with a determined look holds the fake golden banana and points at a sign that says nothing, Papa Ananas sits sadly on a cardboard box behind him

lines.text: Papa, j'ai une idée pour récupérer la maison.
On va la revendre… au vendeur de raisins.
